name: COD Form Checkout
author: sadiksajid

sections.description:
COD Form Checkout is a standalone, lightweight, high-converting Cash on Delivery (COD) and Direct Order checkout solution for WordPress.

Designed specifically for direct-response marketing, single-product funnels, dropshipping, and COD merchants who want high conversions without the speed-killing overhead, database bloat, and complexity of WooCommerce.

Key Features

  • Zero Dependencies: 100% standalone. Does not require WooCommerce or any external e-commerce framework.
  • Conversion-Optimized Form Builder: Real-time visual form builder with instant live preview.
  • Target Country Selection & Static Prefix:
    • Select 1 target country (e.g. Morocco, Saudi Arabia, UAE) to lock a clean static flag & dial prefix badge (e.g. [ 🇲🇦 +212 ]).
    • Select multiple target countries to enable an interactive country switcher dropdown right on the phone field.
  • Strict Server-Side Phone Number Validation: Authoritative PHP phone validation for 38+ countries with country-specific regex, length rules, and localized error messages.
  • Real-Time Price Recalculation: Instant dynamic quantity stepper (+ / -) with subtotal, shipping fee, and free shipping threshold calculations.
  • Order Management Dashboard: Full order management with custom statuses (Pending, Confirmed, Shipped, Completed, Cancelled), quick status switcher, and one-click CSV export.
  • Single-Count Reach Analytics: Privacy-friendly view reach tracking (counts only 1 view per page load when visitor scrolls to form) and submission count tracking.
  • Direct WhatsApp Integration: Automatically redirect customers to WhatsApp with a pre-filled, formatted order summary to close deals instantly.
  • Google Sheets Webhook Sync: Automatically sync new orders directly to your Google Sheet in real time.
  • 11 Languages & Automatic RTL: English, Arabic (with native Right-to-Left layout), French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, Hindi, and Indonesian.
  • Anti-Spam Honeypot: Silently blocks bot submissions with zero friction for real buyers.

Third-Party Services

This plugin can optionally connect to external third-party services to enhance order processing:

  1. Google Sheets (Google Apps Script Web App):

    • Purpose: If configured by the site administrator in the plugin settings, order data (Order ID, Date, Customer Name, Phone, Address, City, Product, Quantity, Total Amount, Currency) is transmitted via an HTTP POST request to the store owner’s personal Google Apps Script Web App URL.
    • Service Provider: Google LLC.
    • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
    • Data Sent: Customer order details provided on the checkout form. No data is sent unless the merchant explicitly enters their own Google Apps Script Web App URL.

  2. WhatsApp (Click to Chat):

    • Purpose: If WhatsApp redirection is enabled by the site administrator, customers can be redirected to WhatsApp (https://api.whatsapp.com/send or https://wa.me/) with an order confirmation message.
    • Service Provider: Meta Platforms, Inc. / WhatsApp LLC.
    • Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
    • Data Sent: Customer order summary encoded in the URL query string.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sadiksajid-cod-order-forms folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the zip file directly via Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Quick Checkout → Forms in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Click Add New Form or edit the default form.
  5. Configure your product, pricing, target countries, theme, and language.
  6. Copy the generated shortcode (e.g. [sadiksajid_cod_form id="123"]) and paste it into any post, page, or landing page builder (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Beaver Builder, etc.).
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to use this plugin?

No! COD Form Checkout is completely standalone and does not require WooCommerce. It includes its own built-in order management, product catalog, and checkout processing.

Can I use it alongside WooCommerce?

Yes. If you have WooCommerce installed, COD Form Checkout works independently without conflict.

How does phone validation work?

When a customer submits the form, authoritative PHP server-side validation checks the phone number against the selected target country’s specific telecom regex and digit length rules. If invalid, the order is safely rejected and a localized error message is displayed.

Can I customize the colors and styling?

Yes. The form builder includes 6 modern pre-designed themes (Emerald Green, Ocean Blue, Sunset Orange, Royal Violet, Midnight Dark, Rose Pink) and allows custom primary colors, button colors, and border radius.

Where are orders stored?

Orders are stored directly in your WordPress database under the Quick Checkout → Orders admin menu with full order details and status management.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Security: Removed transient database writes from view tracking to prevent cache pollution.
  • Compliance: Updated admin submenu slugs to use distinctive “sadik-cod-” prefix.
  • WordPress Standards: Complete prefix refactoring and strict nonce validation.

1.3.0

  • Added Target Country selection with single static prefix and multi-country dropdown selector.
  • Added authoritative server-side PHP phone number validation for 38+ countries with localized error messaging.
  • Added single-count view reach tracking using transient deduplication per page load.
  • Added country flag display in admin Orders list.
  • Improved security: native nonce checks across all AJAX endpoints and eliminated raw SQL queries.

1.2.0

  • Added Google Sheets real-time synchronization via Webhook.
  • Added instant WhatsApp click-to-chat redirection with customizable templates.
  • Added Products and Bundles/Packs inventory manager.

1.1.0

  • Added 11 language translations with automatic Arabic RTL direction.
  • Added sticky mobile bottom order bar.
  • Added honeypot anti-spam protection.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of COD Form Checkout.
